'''Daro Desyk''' was a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a member of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Desyk was [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the [[Black Sun territory]] on Coruscant<ref name="Encounter" /> around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Daro Desyk first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Black Sun Boss: Daro Desyk," introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
